gold_review.explanation: All rewards read task_type/test_strings/expected_matches from kwargs["info"], but _build_dataset stores them as top-level columns and never sets info, so info={} for every row: every task is graded as "generate" with no test strings and any line that compiles as a regex (the exact reference or "I think the answer is 0.") gets a flat 0.5, while explain/match scorers never fire. The env cannot distinguish correct from wrong answers.
gold_review.evidence: src regex_craft/__init__.py:284-285 info=kwargs.get("info", {}); task_type=info.get("task_type","generate"), :299-300 test_strings from info, :316-318 "return 0.5  # valid regex, can't verify", :411-418 rows have task_type/test_strings columns but no "info"; gold_raw.log regex_correctness r1: [0.5]*5 == garbage 0.5
